question.text: XYZ Ltd. announces a buyback through tender offer at Rs.500 per share for a total of Rs.50 crore. Assuming a single pro-rata pool with no separate small-shareholder/general categories, if total shares tendered by all shareholders are 20 lakh shares, what is the overall acceptance ratio?

explanation.text: The Logic: Maximum shares the company will buy = Rs.50,00,00,000 / Rs.500 = 10,00,000 shares (10 lakh). Total tendered = 20 lakh. Overall acceptance ratio = 10 lakh / 20 lakh = 50%. The Trap: Candidates may forget to derive the maximum shares from the buyback amount and price, or confuse the total buyback amount with a per-share quantity. Note: In an actual tender buyback, acceptance is proportionate within categories (small-shareholder vs general) with entitlement calculations; this question isolates the simplified single-pool overall ratio.
